_doc: Talent trees (TalentManager.gd, docs/design/TALENTS.md). 1 point per level from first_point_level; a tier-T node needs tier_points[T-1] points spent in its branch; nodes with 'skill' unlock that skill; effects are per rank.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.description: Sword and board: the shield of the party.

iai.name: Iai
iai.description: The art of the draw: one perfect cut.

kenjutsu.name: Kenjutsu
kenjutsu.description: Reading the opponent; the great katana.

war_wolf.name: War Wolf
war_wolf.description: The tank that will not fall.

verdant_heart.name: Verdant Heart
verdant_heart.description: Harmony with Elandria, Nimue and Fenrisulfr.

bear.name: Bear Form
bear.description: Elandria's bear: raw strength and resilience.

alraune.name: Alraune
alraune.description: The flower spirit: healing and control.

wildcaller.name: Wildcaller
wildcaller.description: Storms, frost and thorns of the wild.

restoration.name: Restoration
restoration.description: Healing that can mend the gravest wound.

barrier_arts.name: Barrier Arts
barrier_arts.description: Seals and wards of the Ancient Ones.

kotodama.name: Kotodama
kotodama.description: Words of power older than the gods.

conflux.name: Conflux
conflux.description: Fire and ice, the classic contradiction.

fifth_element.name: The Fifth Element
fifth_element.description: Conversion of the four, toward Aether.

predator.name: Predator
predator.description: Pacts with Fenrisulfr and the Manticore.

roc.name: Roc
roc.description: The Roc's speed and the open sky.

life_drinker.name: Life Drinker
life_drinker.description: Your own life, and others', as fuel.

gravecaller.name: Gravecaller
gravecaller.description: Bone and the cold of the grave.

shield_discipline.name: Shield Discipline
shield_discipline.description: Drilled behind the shield in the Grand Cathedral.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.description: Slam your shield into the foe, knocking it off balance.

unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
unbreakable.description: When the line is about to break, you hold.

aegis_of_dawn.name: Aegis of Dawn
aegis_of_dawn.description: Solara's light hardens into a radiant aegis that heals and turns blows back.

righteous_fury.name: Righteous Fury
righteous_fury.description: Your strikes carry the Radiant Dawn.

radiant_cleave.name: Radiant Cleave
radiant_cleave.description: A sweeping blow trailing holy light that dazzles every foe.

sanctified_blows.name: Sanctified Blows
sanctified_blows.description: Strike the reeling and the blinded with judgement.

solaras_verdict.name: Solara's Verdict
solaras_verdict.description: Call down the full judgement of the Radiant Dawn on one foe.

lay_on_hands.name: Lay on Hands
lay_on_hands.description: Mend an ally's wounds with a touch of Solara's grace.

dawns_embrace.name: Dawn's Embrace
dawns_embrace.description: Wrap an ally in the dawn itself: a great heal that keeps on mending.

swift_draw.name: Swift Draw
swift_draw.description: The blade is out before the eye can follow.

flash_draw.name: Flash Draw
flash_draw.description: A lightning-quick draw cut that opens a bleeding wound.

iai_mastery.name: Iai Mastery
iai_mastery.description: Years of drawing the same cut.

killing_intent.name: Killing Intent
killing_intent.description: A wounded foe is a finished foe.

thousand_cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
thousand_cuts.description: A storm of draws too fast to see, cutting every foe.

kiai.name: Kiai
kiai.description: A spirit shout that shakes the enemy's footing.

spirit_of_amakiri.name: Spirit of Amakiri
spirit_of_amakiri.description: Channel the founder's spirit: speed, strength and a blade no one can touch.

read_the_opponent.name: Read the Opponent
read_the_opponent.description: Study the foe and find the opening for a decisive cut.

decisive_strike.name: Decisive Strike
decisive_strike.description: When the opening comes, end it.

heaven_splitter.name: Heaven Splitter
heaven_splitter.description: One overhead cut said to split the sky.

heavy_hands.name: Heavy Hands
heavy_hands.description: The heavier the weapon, the better.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.description: Spin with your weapon, battering everything around you.

berserker_rage.name: Berserker Rage
berserker_rage.description: Give yourself fully to Arathorn's fury: huge Strength and Endurance and an Enraged frenzy.

thirst.name: Thirst
thirst.description: Every wound you deal feeds you.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.description: A savage flurry against one foe; devastating on a bleeding target.

fenrisulfrs_maw.name: Fenrisulfr's Maw
fenrisulfrs_maw.description: The Wild Father's jaws close on every foe and drink deep.

war_howl.name: War Howl
war_howl.description: Howl like the war wolf; foes lose their nerve and footing.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.description: Hardest to kill when nearly dead.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Rise again from the brink with a roar.

ox_kick.name: Ox Kick
ox_kick.description: A low, heavy kick that takes the legs out from under the foe.

five_animal_fury.name: Five Animal Fury
five_animal_fury.description: Tiger, crane, mantis, ox and serpent in one devastating sequence.

crane_wing_sweep.name: Crane Wing Sweep
crane_wing_sweep.description: Sweeping wing strikes that spin every foe around.

flowing_water.name: Flowing Water
flowing_water.description: Move like water around the blow.

heavenly_crane.name: Heavenly Crane
heavenly_crane.description: Become untouchable: soaring agility and a body that mends itself.

earth_mothers_palm.name: Earth Mother's Palm
earth_mothers_palm.description: A palm strike carrying Elandria's weight; it can shatter what is frozen.

nimues_tide.name: Nimue's Tide
nimues_tide.description: Let the Spirit Weaver's tide wash through you, healing deep wounds.

disarming_strike.name: Disarming Strike
disarming_strike.description: Knock the foe's weapon aside and leave it reeling.

blade_storm.name: Blade Storm
blade_storm.description: A whirlwind of steel that cuts through every foe.

twin_fangs.name: Twin Fangs
twin_fangs.description: Two quick thrusts that link into your next move.

hundred_blades.name: Hundred Blades
hundred_blades.description: An unbroken torrent of strikes on one foe.

pinning_thrust.name: Pinning Thrust
pinning_thrust.description: Pin the target in place and mark it for the kill.

iron_gauntlet.name: Iron Gauntlet
iron_gauntlet.description: The guild's creed made flesh: strength, precision and resolve.

shadow_mark.name: Shadow Mark
shadow_mark.description: Brand the target with Tsukuyomi's shadow; it cannot hide from you.

lethality.name: Lethality
lethality.description: Every thrust finds a vital point.

moonless_night.name: Moonless Night
moonless_night.description: Vanish into darkness and strike once, perfectly.

phoenix_flower.name: Phoenix Flower
phoenix_flower.description: Fire release: a spray of burning flowers.

raijins_descent.name: Raijin's Descent
raijins_descent.description: Lightning release: the storm god's strike falls on every foe.

shuriken_storm.name: Shuriken Storm
shuriken_storm.description: A fan of shuriken across every foe.

poisoned_tools.name: Poisoned Tools
poisoned_tools.description: Everything you throw carries something nasty.

shadow_clone.name: Shadow Clone
shadow_clone.description: Split into shadow clones; foes strike the wrong you.

bear_form.name: Bear Form
bear_form.description: Take the shape of a great bear: stronger, tougher, harder to kill.

elder_bear.name: Elder Bear
elder_bear.description: Become the elder bear and crash into every foe.

alraunes_kiss.name: Alraune's Kiss
alraunes_kiss.description: A blossom's kiss that heals and keeps healing.

garden_of_elandria.name: Garden of Elandria
garden_of_elandria.description: Raise a living garden that heals and shields.

bramble_lash.name: Bramble Lash
bramble_lash.description: Whip the foe with thorned brambles that leave it bleeding.

natures_grasp.name: Nature's Grasp
natures_grasp.description: Your effects take hold more often.

wrath_of_the_wild.name: Wrath of the Wild
wrath_of_the_wild.description: A howling blizzard sweeps the battlefield.

hammer_of_dawn.name: Hammer of Dawn
hammer_of_dawn.description: A blessed blow that rocks the foe on its feet.

solaras_hammer.name: Solara's Hammer
solaras_hammer.description: Bring down the Radiant Dawn's hammer on one foe.

divine_blessing.name: Divine Blessing
divine_blessing.description: Bless an ally: Fortitude and Endurance up and steady regeneration.

miracle.name: Miracle
miracle.description: A true miracle of the Dawn: an enormous heal.

purifying_flame.name: Purifying Flame
purifying_flame.description: Holy fire that sears the unclean.

judgement_mastery.name: Judgement Mastery
judgement_mastery.description: The blinded and burning are judged harder.

dawnfire.name: Dawnfire
dawnfire.description: The sky ignites with the first light: holy fire on every foe.

sacred_seal.name: Sacred Seal
sacred_seal.description: Press an ofuda seal onto the foe, binding its spirit.

torii_of_the_ancients.name: Torii of the Ancients
torii_of_the_ancients.description: Raise a gate of the Ancient Ones over an ally: warded, healing, reflecting.

spirit_exchange.name: Stamina Conversion
spirit_exchange.description: Draw the foe's stamina and turn it into your mana.

communion.name: Communion
communion.description: Commune with the Ancient Ones; their power floods an ally with life.

spirit_lance.name: Spirit Lance
spirit_lance.description: A spear of pure spirit, unbound by element.

voice_of_nyxara.name: Voice of Nyxara
voice_of_nyxara.description: Speak a word from before creation; every foe reels.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.description: Pull a burning star down on every foe.

tidal_wave.name: Tidal Wave
tidal_wave.description: A wave crashes over every foe and leaves them drenched.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.description: A living storm of wind and lightning.

elemental_convergence.name: Elemental Convergence
elemental_convergence.description: Fire, ice, lightning and earth fused in one bolt; it answers any combo.

aether_nova.name: Aether Nova
aether_nova.description: A glimpse of the fifth element: pure Aether, beyond any resistance.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.description: Mark your prey; the pack will not lose it.

call_of_fenrisulfr.name: Call of Fenrisulfr
call_of_fenrisulfr.description: The Wild Father answers: spectral wolves tear through every foe.

behemoth_charge.name: Behemoth Charge
behemoth_charge.description: Charge with the Behemoth's weight and bowl the foe over.

earthshaker.name: Earthshaker
earthshaker.description: The Behemoth stamps; the ground breaks under every foe.

roc_dive.name: Roc Dive
roc_dive.description: Plunge from above with talons first.

sky_hunter.name: Sky Hunter
sky_hunter.description: Marked prey can't escape the sky.

storm_of_feathers.name: Storm of Feathers
storm_of_feathers.description: The Roc's wings whip up a storm of razor feathers.

crippling_hex.name: Crippling Hex
crippling_hex.description: Wither Strength, Agility and Fortitude and blind the foe.

hels_decree.name: Hel's Decree
hels_decree.description: The Shadow Keeper's decree: every foe weakens and rots.

blood_rite.name: Blood Rite
blood_rite.description: Pay with your own blood for a devastating bolt of shadow.

perfect_drain.name: Perfect Drain
perfect_drain.description: Tear the life from a foe and take all of it for yourself.

bone_spear.name: Bone Spear
bone_spear.description: A lance of bone that tears and bleeds.

danse_macabre.name: Danse Macabre
danse_macabre.description: The dead rise and dance through the enemy ranks.
